breakdown.title: The House That Held a Village
breakdown.logline: A dreamer wanders through a house bigger inside than out: a European village with a curly-haired piper, impossible back stairs, a tiny room where a kind woman cooks, a short drive with an aunt, and a quiet ending with blue balloons.
breakdown.world_logic: The impossible is accepted as normal: a house contains a whole village, stairs appear where none should be, and tiny rooms hold a woman and a stove.

moments.action: The dreamer stands just inside the Meads's house, facing a European village with a cobblestone street.
moments.visual_point: a whole village inside a house
moments.dream: the house is bigger inside than out

moments.action: A Pied-Piper sort of man with curly hair juggles on the cobblestone street.

scenes.title: The impossible stairs and the tiny room

moments.action: The dreamer goes up the back stairs, then straight down the other side.
moments.visual_point: two sets of stairs back to back
moments.dream: the real house doesn't have any stairs there

moments.action: The dreamer walks down a short empty hallway and turns a corner to find a tiny room.
moments.visual_point: a tiny room at the end

moments.action: A young woman with shoulder-length blonde hair in a pageboy cooks at a stove that almost fills the tiny room; she is nice to the dreamer.
moments.visual_point: the woman cooking in the tiny room
moments.dream: a room barely big enough for a stove, yet she cooks

scenes.title: The short drive with the aunt

moments.action: The dreamer waits outside for the aunt; the aunt arrives in a little round convertible.
The dreamer and the aunt drive across a little bridge over a creek, then double back.
The aunt drops the dreamer off at the house again.
moments.visual_point: the dreamer back at the house

moments.action: The dreamer sits with a couple of people, playing with a string of blue balloons.

style_options.name: a faded old photograph
style_options.dream: light that comes from nowhere and casts no clear shadow
style_options.line: sepia tones that hold the feel of an old memory.
style_options.lighting_rules: Light is even and directionless, as if coming from all around. Shadows are soft and faint, barely defining forms. Vignetting darkens the edges, keeping focus on the centre.

style_options.name: a faded watercolour sketch
style_options.dream: edges a little too soft to hold
style_options.line: loose washes that feel like a memory of a place.
style_options.lighting_rules: Colours are muted and blend into one another, with no strong contrast. Edges are soft, as if the scene is seen through water. Light is diffuse, gently washing over everything without harsh shadows.

style_options.name: an old-fashioned engraving
style_options.dream: the stillness of a held breath
style_options.line: fine etched lines that give the scene a timeless, storybook feel.
style_options.lighting_rules: Light is implicit, shown only through varying density of hatched lines. There are no shadows, only darker areas of crosshatching to suggest depth. The overall effect is flat and detailed, like an illustration in an old book.

style_options.name: how it really looked
style_options.dream: the impossible made ordinary, as if it were real life
style_options.line: clear, naturalistic detail with the quietness of a real place.
style_options.lighting_rules: Light is natural and even, as on an overcast day, with soft shadows that define shapes without drama. Edges are crisp enough to feel real, but the overall mood is calm and unremarkable. Nothing is exaggerated; the scene is simply there.
